exercises.name: Dead Hang
instructions: Grip a pull-up bar with hands about shoulder-width apart.
Lift your feet and hang with straight arms, shoulders relaxed away from the ears.
Breathe steadily and hold for the target time, then step down with control.

exercises.name: Neck Bridge
instructions: Use a padded mat. Start on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Press through your feet and lift your hips so part of your weight rests on the top of the head; keep most weight on the feet.
Hold briefly with a neutral neck, then lower slowly. Stop if you feel any pain.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Stand about a stride in front of a bench and rest the top of your back foot on it.
Holding dumbbells at your sides, lower your back knee toward the floor.
Drive through the front foot to stand back up. Finish all reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Squeeze Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding two dumbbells pressed together over your chest, palms facing each other.
Squeeze the dumbbells together hard and keep squeezing for the whole set.
Lower them to the chest together, then press back up.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
instructions: Set a bench to a low incline and lie face down with your chest on the pad.
Let the dumbbells hang straight down, then row them toward your hips, squeezing the shoulder blades.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.

exercises.name: Weighted Decline Sit-Up
instructions: Hook your feet on a decline bench and hold a plate or dumbbell to your chest.
Curl your torso up until you're upright, leading with the chest.
Lower under control without dropping back.

exercises.name: Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension
instructions: Sit or stand holding one dumbbell with both hands over your head.
Keeping the elbows pointing up, lower the dumbbell behind your head to a deep stretch.
Straighten the arms to lift it back up.

exercises.name: Shoulder Pass-Through
instructions: Hold a band or stick with a wide grip in front of your hips.
With straight arms, lift it over your head and behind you as far as is comfortable.
Bring it back the same way. Use a wider grip if it feels tight.

exercises.name: 90/90 Hip Switch
instructions: Sit with both knees bent at 90 degrees, one leg in front of you and one to the side.
Sit tall and lean gently over the front shin.
Rotate both knees to the other side to switch, and repeat.

exercises.name: Wrist & Ankle Circles
instructions: Circle each wrist slowly, 10 times each direction.
Lift one foot and circle the ankle 10 times each direction, then switch.
